signIn.title: Sign in to Antigravity
signIn.body: Sign in with the Google account to use Antigravity with, the way the Antigravity app does.
signIn.risk.title: Risk to the account
signIn.risk.body: Google may suspend an account it sees used outside Antigravity. Use a Google account you can afford to lose.
signIn.noClient: This build carries no Antigravity OAuth client. Set the client ID and secret in the plugin's settings.
signIn.paste.body: Sign in with Google. The page it ends on will not load: copy its whole address from the browser's address bar and paste it below (or just the code in it).
signIn.paste.label: Address the sign-in ended on
signIn.error.empty: Paste the address the sign-in ended on.
signIn.error.notAddress: That isn't the address the sign-in page came back to.
signIn.error.otherSignIn: That address is from another sign-in; start this one again.
